SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AppSettings
Application-wide preferences for the Database Manager, persisted as JSON by ProfileStore.
ColumnMeta
Metadata for one column of a query result, captured from ResultSetMetaData so the grid can render and edit values without touching the (now closed) live result set.
ConnectionDialog
A modal form for creating or editing a ConnectionProfile: choose a driver (which pre-fills the JDBC URL template and driver class), enter the URL, credentials and per-connection options, and optionally test the connection before saving.
ConnectionManager
The application controller: owns the persisted profiles and settings, the driver registry, and the set of currently open DbSessions.
ConnectionProfile
A saved JDBC connection profile: everything needed to reach one database.
ConnectionProvider
Opens, tests and closes JDBC Connections from a ConnectionProfile, independent of any particular database.
ConnectionProvider.TestResult
The outcome of a ConnectionProvider.test(org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.model.ConnectionProfile, org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.model.AppSettings) call.
CsvExporter
Exports a QueryResult to RFC 4180 CSV: a header row of column labels followed by the data rows, with fields quoted and internal quotes doubled only when they contain a comma, quote, CR or LF.
DbDriver
A JDBC driver description: the metadata the UI needs to let a user build a connection URL without hand-typing it, and the driver class to load.
DbManagerMainPanel
The Database Manager's root panel: a toolbar, the connection navigator on the left, a tabbed SQL editor/results area on the right, and a message log with a status line at the bottom.
DbSession
One live connection to one database plus the helpers that operate on it: the query executor (with cancellation), the metadata reader, and transaction control.
DdlGenerator
Generates a best-effort CREATE TABLE statement from JDBC column metadata, for the navigator's "view DDL" action.
DmlBuilder
Builds parameterized INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE statements from grid edits, so committing a data change never string-concatenates user values (which would risk both SQL injection and quoting bugs).
DmlBuilder.PreparedSql
A statement plus its ordered bind values.
DmlBuilder.TableRef
A table reference.
DriverRegistry
The catalogue of JDBC drivers the Database Manager knows about: the built-in drivers whose jars ship on the runtime classpath, plus any user-added custom drivers.
MetadataReader
Reads database structure (catalogs, schemas, tables, columns, keys) through the standard JDBC DatabaseMetaData API, so the navigator works against any driver without database-specific SQL.
MetadataReader.ColumnInfo
A column of a table.
MetadataReader.ForeignKeyInfo
A foreign-key relationship from a table to a parent table.
MetadataReader.TableInfo
A table or view.
NavigatorTree
The database navigator: a lazy JTree of saved connection profiles that expands into schemas, tables/views and columns on demand.
NavigatorTree.Actions
Callbacks the navigator needs from the hosting panel.
NavigatorTree.TableSelection
The table a user double-clicked, resolved to its qualified coordinates.
PasswordObfuscator
Reversible obfuscation for the optional saved database passwords.
ProfileStore
Persists the Database Manager's state as JSON under a configuration directory: connection profiles, application settings and user-added custom drivers.
ProfileStore.StoreException
Signals that persisted state could not be written.
QueryExecutor
Runs SQL against a live connection and captures the outcome into an immutable QueryResult, applying a fetch size, a query timeout and a hard row cap.
QueryResult
The outcome of executing one SQL statement: either a row set, an update count, or an error.
ResultsTable
The results grid: a JTable over a paging ResultTableModel, with First/Prev/Next/Last controls, a page-position label and a one-line message showing the last result's row count / update count / error.
ResultTableModel
A read-only TableModel that pages over the rows of a QueryResult held in memory.
SettingsDialog
A modal form for the application-wide AppSettings: row caps, paging, timeouts, null text, editor font size, and the security-sensitive "allow saving passwords" switch (with an explicit warning).
SqlEditorTab
One SQL editor tab: a syntax-highlighted query pane on top, a Run/Stop bar, and the results grid below.
SqlEditorTab.Runner
Supplies the currently active connection and settings to the tab.
SqlHighlighter
Lightweight SQL syntax highlighting for a JTextPane: keywords, string literals, numbers and -- / /* */ comments are colored as the user types.
SqlStatementSplitter
Splits a SQL script into individual statements on semicolons, ignoring separators that appear inside string literals, quoted identifiers or comments.
